jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern, Backend
jobs.content:
We are looking for an intern to work with Python and PostgreSQL.

Requirements: studying Computer Science, SQL, Git. This is a remote position open to candidates in Brazil. You will build APIs, write tests and review code with the team. Benefits include stipend and mentoring.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer
jobs.content: Lead architecture for the platform team. 10+ years required. On-site role in Berlin with occasional travel. You will mentor engineers and own technical direction across multiple squads.
